description: This pie chart illustrates the "Token Routing Distribution (FedHLM)," displaying a total of three distinct categories. The chart does not utilize a separate legend; instead, bolded category labels are positioned directly outside their respective segments, and bolded percentage labels are located inside each slice. The dominant segment, colored green and labeled "LOCAL," accounts for 94.5% of the total distribution. The remaining two categories are visually emphasized by being exploded, or slightly offset, from the main body of the pie. These consist of a red slice labeled "LLM" representing 3.9%, and a smaller blue slice labeled "EDGE_P2P" representing 1.6%. Visually, the chart highlights a stark contrast in proportion, with the single large green segment comprising the vast majority of the area, while the two significantly smaller, offset slices are grouped together to make up the remainder.
caption_used: Token Routing Distribution for FedHLM: The pie chart illustrates the proportion of tokens routed across three categories: LOCAL, EDGE_P2P, and LLM. The LOCAL category dominates with approximately 94.5% of the distribution, while EDGE_P2P and LLM account for roughly 5.5% and 2.5%, respectively. Notably, the EDGE_P2P category has shown a steady increase in its share compared to previous analyses, surpassing LLM in token routing. The chart provides a clear visual representation of these proportions, with percentage labels inside each slice for clarity.
